specification.title: Hiring, evaluation and talent development
specification.outcome: Build defensible hiring and development processes for expert organizations.

genre: Professional institutional leadership with complete original economic/financial models and inspectable decision artifacts; no fabricated real leadership.
requirements: Two complete original expert hiring/development cases, one academic and one financial. Actual job/capability evidence, structured tasks with full keys/rubrics, candidate evidence and consistent evaluation/calibration; feedback/development/succession plan and bias/selection/uncertainty limitations. Full decision memoranda and exact numerical comparisons where relevant. No universal legal hiring rules, unverifiable protected-attribute inference or invented actual candidate data.

Read necessary accepted economic/financial/research/teaching prerequisites and canonical coverage. Use bounded inspected primary sources for unresolved claims; original models and cases. Current laws/regulations or institutional policies require fresh official dated jurisdiction-aware retrieval; do not use broad professional advice as legal authority. Reuse stable verified source scopes with original inspector attribution. No fictional evidence represented as real responsibility.
